criterion_text: The same service in read-only Agent mode rejects push/mutation, denies cross-repository Blob and Manifest access even when digests exist locally, and rejects incomplete/unverified objects or missing authorization.

verifiers.summary: SC-03: the read-only loopback Registry denies all mutation verbs and cross-repository access despite local CAS bytes, requires authorization, and the Agent cache host pulls but cannot push
